name: Push Ups
description: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders. Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body in a straight line, then press back up.

name: Squats
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, then drive up through your heels.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms and toes. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes; don't let your hips sag or pike.

name: Shoulder Taps
description: Plank with shoulder taps

name: Reverse Lunges
description: From standing, step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees. Push through the front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

name: Standing YTW
description: With your arms for a Y, then T, then W

name: Running Jump Rope
description: jog in place while also twirling your hands

name: Squat Pulses
description: pulse at the bottom of the squat position

name: Predator Squats
description: stand with your hand and feet touching in front then pop down to a squat and open your stance and hands wide to the sides

name: Skaters Jumps
description: jump from leg to leg throwing one leg behind the other

name: Copenhagens
description: turn on your side and use one leg to hold up your lower body

name: Side Lunges
description: start standing and throw one leg to the side and lean over it

name: Punch and Kicks
description: punch four times then kick two times

name: Cossack Squat
description: in a wide stand lean to one side and put up the opposite foot. Then do the other side.

name: Sumo Squat
description: stand with a wide stance and your knees slightly bent, point your hands down and squat down.

name: Burpee No Jump
description: start in a standing position, squat down, place your hands on the floor, step back into a plank, step forward into a squat, and stand up. Do not jump at the end.

name: Bridges
description: lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, lift your hips toward the ceiling while squeezing your glutes, then lower back down.

name: Frog Squats
description: stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, squat down and place your hands inside your knees with elbows pushing them outward, then move your butt backwords while maintaining the same height

name: Fast Feet
description: stand with feet shoulder-width apart and quickly run in place by lifting your feet only a few inches off the ground, moving them as fast as possible. Similarly pump your arms.

name: Reverse Table Top Lifts
description: sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you, lift hips upward into a reverse tabletop position, then lower back down while keeping your core tight.

name: Criss Cross Jumps
description: Slight jump up and cross your legs and arms in the air, landing with one foot in front of the other, then jump again crossing the opposite leg in front. Repeat in a rhythmic motion.

name: Jumping Jacks
description: Start with feet together and arms at your sides. Jump while spreading your legs and raising your arms overhead, then return to the starting position.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: Start in a plank position and drive one knee toward your chest, then quickly switch legs in a running motion while keeping your upper body stable.

name: High Knees
description: Run in place while lifting your knees as high as possible toward your chest, keeping a fast rhythm and pumping your arms.

name: Butt Kicks
description: Run in place while kicking your heels up toward your glutes with each step, keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Jump Squats
description: Start in a squat position, then explosively jump up, extending your arms overhead. Land softly back into the squat and repeat.

name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
description: Lie on your side with legs extended. Lift your top leg upward while keeping it straight, then lower it back down under control.

name: Side-Lying Inner Thigh Lift
description: Lie on your side and cross your top leg over in front of you. Keep your bottom leg straight and lift it upward to engage the inner thigh, then slowly lower it.

name: Sumo Squat Adductor Isometric Hold
description: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out. Squat down and place your elbows inside your knees. Push outward gently with your elbows while actively trying to squeeze your legs inward using your adductors. Hold the isometric contraction.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended slightly back. Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso while keeping your back straight, and extend the free leg behind you for balance. Return to standing.

name: Inchworm Walkout
description: Stand tall, then bend forward and walk your hands out into a plank position. Hold briefly, then walk your hands back toward your feet and return to standing.

name: Curtsy Lunge
description: Stand tall and step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy position, lowering into a lunge. Keep your torso upright, then return to standing and repeat on the other side.

name: Dead Bug
description: Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor while keeping your core engaged. Return to start and switch sides.

name: Bird Dog
description: Start on hands and knees in a tabletop position. Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back while keeping your spine neutral. Hold briefly, then return to start and switch sides.

name: Side Plank with Hip Drop
description: From a side plank position, lower your hips toward the floor, then lift them back up to plank height. Repeat for the set duration while keeping your body aligned.

name: Worlds Greatest Stretch
description: From a lunge position, place both hands inside your front foot. Rotate your torso and extend your inside arm toward the ceiling, then return and switch sides. This dynamic stretch improves mobility in hips, hamstrings, and spine.

name: Renegade Rows (on knees)
description: From a kneeling position, retrack one arm behind you while using the other arm for support. TThen alternate sides.

name: Side Gorillas
description: From a squat position, place your hands on the floor to one side, now turn your hip and hop laterally to where you hands are.

name: Side Crawl
description: Start in a high plank position with knees crouched and your hands under your shoulders. Now shuffle with your arms and legs one way.

name: Lateral Runs
description: Run in place while also moving to the sides

name: Low Rotation Chops
description: Squat down and turn your legs to the left than the right moving your hands to that side.

name: Reverse Snow Angels
description: Lie face down with arms at your sides, palms facing down. Lift your chest slightly off the ground and sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead, then return them to your sides, mimicking a snow angel motion.

name: Lateral Shuffle Taps
description: Start in an athletic stance with knees bent and chest up. Quickly shuffle laterally a few steps, then reach down with your hand to tap the floor.

name: Supermans
description: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the ground while squeezing your glutes and lower back.

name: Standing Cross Crunch
description: Stand tall with hands behind your head. Bring your right elbow down toward your left knee as you lift the knee across your body, engaging your obliques. Return to start and repeat on the other side.

name: Donkey Kicks
description: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg up toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes.

name: Wall Sits
description: Squat down with your back against a wall and hold.

name: Brock Shuffle
description: Start in a push up position, put all of your weight on your right hand and kick out that leg to the opposite side.

name: Crab Reaches
description: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and feet flat. Lift hips off the ground into a reverse tabletop. Reach one arm overhead and kick out the opposite leg.

name: Bridge Marches
description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Lift hips into a bridge. Alternate lifting each knee toward your chest while keeping hips stable. Lower and repeat for the other leg.

name: Chair Hip Raises
description: Lie on your back and put your heels on a chair with knees bent. Flex your glutes and raise knees up.

name: Hamstring Slides
description: Start in a bridge position and keep one leg bent while extending and contracting the leg on a slider.

name: Step Ups
description: Step up onto a platform and drive the opposite knee.

name: Alligator Crawl
description: Start prone and stay low move your arms and legs with your knees as close to the floor as possible.

name: Bear Crawl
description: Walk forward on all fours.

name: Reverse Flys
description: On your stomach with your arms like a T, raise them back.

name: Plank Jacks
description: Hold a plank while opening and closing your legs

name: Plank Hops
description: Hold a plank while hopping your legs to the side and the middle.

name: Plank Ups
description: Start in a plank and continuously alternate your arms between your elbows and hands.

name: Dead Hangs
description: Hang on a pull-up bar either in the air or supported

name: Sprawl
description: Start standing and then squat down putting your hands in front, lean forward and kick your legs back to a plank. Then reverse.

name: Standing Oblique
description: Start standing with your hands behind your head and then crunch to one side and raise that same knee up to meet your elbow.

name: Bicycle Crunches
description: Lie down on your back with your hands behind your head. Alternate turning your head and tapping your elbow and opposite knee.

name: Side Planks
description: Hold a plank on your side.

name: Star Toe Touch Twists
description: Sit on your butt with your legs and arms wide. Twist your torso to the right and lift your right leg while grabbing with your left hand.

name: Lunge Jumps
description: Get in a lunge stance and jump in the air landing in the reverse lunge stance.

name: Touchdown Jacks
description: Start standing and jump your legs wide while dropping into a squat and touch the ground with one hand.

name: Airplanes
description: Stand on one leg and lean a little bit forward open your arms like a plane. Now slowly turn to the left and back to the right.

name: Wall Slides
description: Back to the wall, form your arms into a T and push your arms against the wall behind you, then push your arms up.

name: Floor Dips
description: Sit on the floor with legs extended, put your arms down and bend them then push up.

name: Floor Elbow Rows
description: lie on your back with legs bent, have your elbows out at 90 degrees and push off with them.

name: T Extension
description: Lie on your stomach with your arms out like a T with your thumbs up. Raise your arms up from the floor.

name: Side V Crunch
description: Lie on one side with your bottom hand straight in-front. Now crunch both legs and your top elbow in.

name: Side Plank Crunch
description: Start in a side plank with your top hand extended up. Now crunch your top elbow and top leg together.

name: Plank Walkout
description: Start in a plank and then walk your hands forward and then back.

name: Clamshells
description: Start on your side, rotated downward, and then push up to a side plank on your knees while rotating out and extending your opposite leg high

name: Ab Crunch
description: Lie on your back with your legs crossed in the air. Crunch up.

name: Toe Taps
description: Lie on your back with your legs bent and arms down at your side. Alternate reaching down to your left then right sides.
